created_prompt:
Help me create a business plan.

I currently post cooking videos on social media to 1.2 million followers. I focus on quick and healthy recipes and I receive good feedback.

I need a three-year plan to both grow online and publish a cookbook. Please offer advice on whether the cookbook should be traditionally-published or self-published. Provide pros and cons for each.

I work four days a week and am limited in time and budget.
